aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes software for food trucks: online orders, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software specially for food trucks and mobile food businesses, helping them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders running smoothly and spend less time answering the same old questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was made to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: However, most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make a food truck business easier to run, with tools designed around how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with one simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After making Village Foodie, a directory helping people find food trucks coming to their area, I spent more time understanding the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks keep moving, sell at different locations and serve customers in conditions that are always changing.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can really manage. The system works it out from each dish’s preparation time and how many portions you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does this system stop my kitchen being overwhelmed?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set a weekly schedule of places and times, then customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Can it be used at changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract period and no notice period. You can stop any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance, and your access stays active until the end of the month already paid for.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract period?

comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till app and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your till app is best asked of your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering app takes online orders before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, then the order appears in your kitchen. A till app or card terminal takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering app?

faq.phrases.appsOffline: The iPad and Android app keeps taking walk-up orders on the spot without signal and sends them as soon as you are back online; the web dashboard needs a connection.
faq.phrases.appsSentence: There is also an iPad and Android app, which can keep taking walk-up orders on the spot when the signal drops.
faq.phrases.webOffline: The web dashboard needs a connection to show new orders.
featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a particular date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand it over, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when orders are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene certificates, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming schedule on your own website. Each date links directly to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with special prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS), and at the same time the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. As soon as a slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward loyal customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into bundle deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own accounts with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps you able to take orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an ordering deadline for items that need to be ordered early.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, complete with their own ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each menu item and see your real profit at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website, or from a photo you already posted on Facebook. You just check and confirm.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. As soon as a pickup time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the till counter, the laptop inside the truck — and the card machine (EDC) you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering apps assume your business has a fixed address, stable wifi and the same opening hours every week. But you sell in a new place every week, at different hours, with patchy signal or even no signal. HatchGrab was made for those conditions.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses automatically so customers don’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you usually post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in the dates, locations and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you selling tonight?” “What desserts are there?” Your WhatsApp still gets answered while you drive to your selling spot or are busy at the grill, based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you selling tonight?” “What desserts are there?” Soon your WhatsApp will get answered while you drive to your selling spot or are busy at the grill. Messenger and Instagram to follow.
